$comment: VENDORED copy of the normative kiosk.tech schema at spec/schemas/discovery.schema.json. It is here so e2e/schema_conformance.rb can validate this origin's LIVE wire bytes against the PUBLISHED schema with no second checkout and no network fetch (K-822). Identical to the upstream copy as PARSED JSON once this $comment is removed — bin/check-spec-schemas asserts exactly that whenever the umbrella layout puts kiosk.tech next to this repo, and says so rather than pretending when it does not. T-045 tracks the sync-check.
title: Kiosk discovery document
description: The JSON served at GET /.well-known/kiosk.json (Kiosk protocol 0.4).

version.description: Discovery-document FORMAT version (currently "1.0"), independent of the protocol version.

issuer.description: The AP2 mandate iss anchor and the token iss/aud. An absolute https URL.

endpoint.description: The wire-verb root (base URL + mount path), e.g. https://example.com/kiosk.

capabilities.description: The MODULES this endpoint serves, from the canonical set, in canonical order. Never the origin's registered verb NAMES -- this document is a POINTER, not a copy of the contract, and the names are published once, in the catalog at `schema_url`. This is also the ONLY place the module set appears: the catalog carried a byte-identical copy as `verbs` until protocol 0.4 dropped it.

schema_url.description: Where to fetch the catalog. It MUST resolve to the same document as GET <endpoint>/schema, which is UNAUTHENTICATED. It MAY carry a cache-busting version parameter; when it does, the operator MUST change it whenever the catalog changes, and MAY then serve that URL immutable for a long time. The bare <endpoint>/schema is a fixed URL whose bytes change, so it may not be cached for longer than this document is.

owner.description: Provider-chosen contact info (optional); SHOULD include at least an email.

skill.description: Optional pinned skill reference. Omitted entirely when no skill is pinned.

url.description: A versioned, immutable skill URL on kiosk.tech (skill-vX.Y.Z.md).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the skill file content.
